style.detailed_brief: Permanent Animal Kingdom standard pet style. Existing Meadow and Forest pets guide artistic style ONLY; never copy source meshes or transfer their species anatomy. All standard furry quadrupeds sit on their hindquarters, hind legs folded outward, torso gently upright, BOTH separate forelegs extend forward down to TWO front paws/feet firmly touching the same ground plane, visibly weight bearing. Compact pear-shaped rounded bodies, rounded oversized baby heads, slightly oversized expressive near-black eyes with small bright catchlights, adorable warm eyelids, gentle smiles. Beautiful rich soft natural fur: sculpted layered locks with finely painted individual strands, soft underfur and natural directional flow, varied organic coloration, matte high roughness zero metalness, no toy plastic sheen. Rich detailed high-quality geometry and organic shading. Keep face readable; no invented crests, horns or unnatural protrusions. This Jungle pair is an original juvenile tapir with cocoa fur, cream broken juvenile stripes/spots, tiny rounded white-rim ears and short flexible broad tapir nose, and an original ocelot kitten with golden tawny soft fur, black rosettes/elongated spots, cream muzzle chest and paws, small rounded feline ears, short rounded muzzle and softly curved ringed tail. Tapir forefeet have species-correct broad padded toes, feline front paws are round; both pets have four limbs and seated ground contact. Dinosaurs/mythical creatures can retain appropriate scales/armor while remaining cute. No birds for this pair. The attached existing Forest bear image supplies soft sculpted fur and painterly organic shading STYLE ONLY. Never reproduce bear anatomy, ears, muzzle, markings, pose details or scene. Both forepaws of new pets MUST be extended forward flat on ground. No glossy ceramic figurines. Single new animal centered on empty neutral background.
